imagePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source frame for an animated macOS desktop companion. Create ONE chibi anime swordsman strongly inspired by Inosuke Hashibira from Demon Slayer: shaggy gray boar-head mask with prominent pink snout, sharp ivory tusks, pointed furry ears and fierce icy-blue eyes; compact athletic bare torso, shaggy brown fur pelt at waist, loose charcoal hakama trousers, furry brown leg wraps and simple bare toes, exactly TWO chipped serrated silver katana blades with wrapped handles, one in each hand. Personality conveyed: wild, proud, competitive, funny bravado, confident chest forward. Hand-drawn high-quality 2D anime cel shading, clean dark outline, charming approximately 3.3 heads tall proportions. Full body in a RIGHT-FACING three-quarter side profile, relaxed ready-to-walk stance, both feet planted on the same invisible horizontal ground line, both swords held low beside the body with tips angled slightly forward but ABOVE the feet. Entire character including ears, both blade tips and feet fully visible. Portrait 9:16 composition. Character height 64% of canvas, centered horizontally, top at 18% and soles at 82% with generous empty margins for animated sword swings. Fixed orthographic side camera. Absolutely uniform flat vivid chroma green #00FF00 background, no gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow, environment, text, labels or watermark. No green anywhere in the character. Only one character, exactly two arms and two legs, no additional weapons.
atlasPrompt: Edit the reference character into a clean production-ready 2D CUTOUT PUPPET SPRITE ATLAS for local animation. Preserve exactly the same gray boar mask, blue eyes, pink snout, ivory tusks, bare muscular tan torso, brown fur waist, charcoal trousers, fur leg wraps and two chipped silver swords. Same chibi anime cel shading and RIGHT-FACING three-quarter profile. Output square 1536x1536 with REAL transparent background. Six SEPARATE DISCONNECTED body components, arranged neatly one per cell in a strict evenly spaced 3 columns by 2 rows grid, each component contained entirely inside its cell, no borders or labels. Top-left cell: complete isolated boar head including ears, snout, jaw fur, NO neck or body. Top-middle cell: complete isolated bare torso and brown furry waist, ending at hips, NO head, arms or legs. Top-right cell: complete isolated NEAR arm, from rounded shoulder through bent elbow to closed fist, holding ONE long chipped silver katana angled toward bottom-right; no other body parts. Bottom-left cell: complete isolated FAR arm, from shoulder through elbow to fist holding ONE matching chipped silver katana angled toward bottom-right; no other body parts. Bottom-middle cell: complete isolated NEAR leg, from upper thigh charcoal trouser down through knee, brown furry calf and bare foot pointing RIGHT; full continuous limb, no waist or torso. Bottom-right cell: complete isolated FAR leg, from upper thigh charcoal trouser through knee, brown furry calf and bare foot pointing RIGHT. Limbs should be nearly vertically aligned in neutral slight-bend resting poses. Draw complete hidden joint areas, rounded shoulder and hip stumps with ample overlap for rotation. Keep each part LARGE within its own cell and separated by at least 30 transparent pixels from cell boundaries. No duplicates, no whole assembled figure, no layout decorations, no ground, no shadow, no text. Exactly six cells and six isolated components.

The lowest planted foot stays at the initial ground level. No jumping, no turning around. No effects.
